title: Quercetin as Possible Supportive Therapy for Mild to Moderate Hyperuricemia

sections.abstract: Uric acid, a metabolic byproduct of purine degradation in humans, is a known risk factor for conditions such as gout and type 2 diabetes. Research has shown that supplementation with quercetin can significantly reduce plasma uric acid levels in individuals with mild hyperuricemia, potentially mitigating these associated risks.
